title: Lay out the invoice table
prompt: Billing writes its invoices to a Delta table partitioned by status, and a partner's loader takes files of at most 4 invoices (a tiny limit, so the effect shows on small data). Fix `write_table` so each status gets as few files as the limit allows. `solve` and `layout` are written for you: `layout` reports each status's files from the log.
rules: Partition the table by `status`; invoices with no status are a partition of their own.
No file holds more than 4 invoices.
Each status has as few files as that allows, and every invoice is in the table.
hints: Run the starter on the sample: how many files does `paid` get, and why more than one per partition of the feed?
Each task writes its own file for every status it holds. Put all of a status's invoices in one task first.
A write option caps the rows per file and starts a new file when the cap is reached.
